The problem you're closing

The Integration Pitch

Why Vorro, why CHRISTUS Shreveport-Bossier, why now

CHRISTUS Health's decade-long Epic standardization is paying off system-wide: Converge Wave 2a live, core facilities integrated, and CHRISTUS CareLink letting patients share records across the system and with outside Epic hospitals.

But Epic-to-Epic interoperability only covers part of the picture: payers, labs, imaging partners, and any non-Epic facility CHRISTUS acquires or partners with still need their own connection into the system.

That's where Vorro's pre-built connectors help: extending CHRISTUS Shreveport-Bossier's Epic investment out to payers, labs and non-Epic partners, so Dr. Sinha's clinical team gets the same continuity of data outside the Epic network as inside it.
